entry.title: Kalshi’s named October hike and maintain-rate headings showed 67% and 32%; Polymarket’s named increase and no-change rows showed 66% and 33%. Changes since September 27 evening were small; CME’s live grid remained unreadable.

Kalshi’s named October 25 bp-hike heading rose from 64% to 66% since 13:35 UTC; maintain rate held at 35%. Polymarket’s named 65% hike and 34% no-change rows were unchanged. CME’s live grid was unreadable.

Direct October event-page check: Kalshi’s named hike heading held at 64%, maintain rate eased to 35%; Polymarket again displayed 65% for a 25 bp increase and 34% no change. CME’s grid remained unreadable.
